description: Defines classes and enums for Bluetooth GATT profile management, including services, characteristics, descriptors, and profile discovery logic.

classes.name: GATTProfile
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth GATT profile discovery, services, characteristics, and descriptors.

classes.name: GATTProfile::Service
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT service with its characteristics.

classes.name: GATTProfile::Characteristic
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT characteristic with its descriptors.

classes.name: GATTProfile::Descriptor
classes.description: Represents a descriptor within a GATT characteristic.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers GATT services on a Bluetooth device within a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current profile discovery is valid.

methods.name: Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over discovered services.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds characteristics within a service matching specific UUIDs.

methods.name: FindHandle
methods.description: Finds handle for a characteristic or descriptor.

methods.name: NextCharacteristic
methods.description: Advances to the next characteristic in the profile.

methods.name: LoadCharacteristics
methods.description: Loads characteristics and descriptors for a service.
